note: Set B is better because it correctly associates most values with their specific aberration modes (Spherical, Trefoil, Coma) and identifies the 'Charge' context, whereas Set A fails to link the right-block values to specific modes (binding them to the general design) and mislabels columns as 'Mode 1/2/3'. However, Set B heavily hallucinates conditions (stellar size, suppression) not present in the text, and is inconsistent on column mapping (0.0049 vs 0.53 for Charge 4). Set A also misreads the Wavefront Error column as Allowable RMS. Set B is preferred for capturing the table structure despite the hallucinated metadata.
remarks: Both sets invent conditions/labels not found in the source text (Set A: 'Mode 1/2/3'; Set B: 'stellar size', 'suppression').
